rows.label: bf05030100_0010
rows.name: You are[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf05030100_0020
rows.name:
I am Fan la Norne, an envoy
from the Holy See of Acedia.

rows.label: bf05030100_0030
rows.name: Oh... from the Holy See?

rows.label: bf05030100_0040
rows.name: You are Rex-sama, correct?

rows.label: bf05030100_0050
rows.name:
His Holiness [System:Ruby rt=Malbeni - to curse in Esperanto ]Malbeni[/System:Ruby] requests
an audience. Will you come?

rows.label: bf05030100_0060
rows.name:
Huh? What do you mean[ML:Dash ]? Why would the Pope
want to meet someone like me?

rows.label: bf05030100_0070
rows.name:
The Holy See manages every
Blade and Driver in Alst.

rows.label: bf05030100_0080
rows.name:
And you're the Driver
of Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf05030100_0090
rows.name: So they want that power for themselves?

rows.label: bf05030100_0100
rows.name: That is not the case.

rows.label: bf05030100_0110
rows.name:
His Holiness[ML:Dash ] as a fellow Driver
of Heaven's Holy Grail,

rows.label: bf05030100_0115
rows.name: wishes to meet with you, Rex-sama.

rows.label: bf05030100_0120
rows.name: That is all.

rows.label: bf05030100_0130
rows.name: Fellow[ML:Dash ] It can't be...

rows.label: bf05030100_0140
rows.name: Indeed. His Holiness is Metsu's Driver.

rows.label: bf05030100_0150
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]！！

rows.label: bf05030100_0160
rows.name:
And Rex-sama, you have the dagger
with you now, correct?

rows.label: bf05030100_0170
rows.name: How do you know about the dagger?

rows.label: bf05030100_0180
rows.name:
I can tell. His Holiness is also
the original owner of that dagger.

rows.label: bf05030100_0190
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]！！

rows.label: bf05030100_0200
rows.name:
So the Pope - he's
Cole's Driver as well?

rows.label: bf05030100_0210
rows.name: Yes...

rows.label: bf05030100_0220
rows.name: No way. But the old man is...

rows.label: bf05030100_0230
rows.name:
The current Pope is from Acedia.
It's not out of the question.

rows.label: bf05030100_0240
rows.name: People from Acedia do live long lives, after all.

rows.label: bf05030100_0250
rows.name:
I see[ML:Dash ] So that's why Cole-san
said the dagger's owner

rows.label: bf05030100_0260
rows.name: knows how to reach the World Tree.

rows.label: bf05030100_0270
rows.name: Well, what do you say?

rows.label: bf05030100_0280
rows.name:
An audience with His Holiness Malbeni
should not be a bad thing for you, either.

rows.label: bf05030100_0290
rows.name: Ah, uh[ML:Dash ] W-wait a moment[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf05030100_0300
rows.name:
It's suspicious, Rex. The
story is too convenient.

rows.label: bf05030100_0310
rows.name: What do you think, Hikari?

rows.label: bf05030100_0320
rows.name:
You noticed, right? From the
moment we met Cole-san.

rows.label: bf05030100_0330
rows.name: Yes.

rows.label: bf05030100_0340
rows.name:
Though I never expected
he'd become the Pope.

rows.label: bf05030100_0350
rows.name: Do you want to meet him?

rows.label: bf05030100_0360
rows.name:
There's a lot I want to ask him. I want to know
about what happened after I went to sleep.

rows.label: bf05030100_0370
rows.name: And... why you're here now...

rows.label: bf05030100_0380
rows.name: All right, then. I want to meet him too.

rows.label: bf05030100_0390
rows.name: No[ML:Dash ] I think I have to meet him.
